name: Brand Master Template
description: Locked brand logo, color palette, contact block, legal line, and master-only compliance footer. Customers override logoUri/primaryColor/secondaryColor/contact*/legalDisclaimer/brandName via templates/customers/*.json. Placeholders for hero + campaign copy. masterOnly.complianceText / MasterCompliance is NEVER listed in overrideVariables and must never appear in customer files. exportModes.print vs exportModes.marketing define visibility for later exports.

roles.creator: Full access — configure scopes and placeholders
roles.adopter: Can replace HeroImage fill and edit campaign text variables; cannot move logo, palette, contact, legal line, or master compliance footer

masterOnly.complianceText: Master compliance: Template terms apply. Not for unauthorized redistribution.

variables.value: Master compliance: Template terms apply. Not for unauthorized redistribution.
© Brand Co. All rights reserved. Not for resale.
Replace this body copy with offer details, seasonality, or product benefits.

print.description: Production print plate — HeroImage only (no BrandLogo, copy, contact, legal, or compliance). Sized to product artworkLocation.

marketing.description: Marketing/mockup composition — full brand chrome and campaign copy visible.
